001package org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.playwright;
002
003import java.io.IOException;
004import java.io.UncheckedIOException;
005import java.nio.file.Files;
006import java.util.HashMap;
007import java.util.Map;
008
009import org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.common.telemetry.Telemetry;
010import org.nasdanika.sdk.runtime.harness.Server;
011
012import com.microsoft.playwright.Browser;
013import com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserContext;
014import com.microsoft.playwright.BrowserType;
015import com.microsoft.playwright.Page;
016import com.microsoft.playwright.Playwright;
017import com.microsoft.playwright.Route;
018
019import io.opentelemetry.api.common.AttributeKey;
020import io.opentelemetry.api.common.Attributes;
021import io.opentelemetry.api.common.AttributesBuilder;
022import io.opentelemetry.context.Context;
023
024/**
025 * Runs code that drives a browser against a {@link Server} of the harness, in the trace of the
026 * server: the code runs in a span, each {@link Session#step(String, Session.StepBody) step} is a
027 * child span, and every request the browser sends to the server carries the current span, so the
028 * server's spans are children of the step that caused them.
029 *
030 * <pre>
031 * Harness.inServer("Library", routes -&gt; ..., server -&gt; Browsing.inBrowser(server, session -&gt; {
032 *     session.step("Open the catalog", () -&gt; session.page().navigate("/"));
033 *     session.step("Search", () -&gt; session.page().getByLabel("Title").fill("Dune"));
034 *     return null;
035 * }));
036 * </pre>
037 *
038 * Screenshots, those steps take and those taken with {@link Session#screenshot(String)}, are
039 * written to a directory and reported as log records in the span they were taken in, with the
040 * file's path as an attribute: a recorded trace says what the page looked like at each step. The
041 * browser's console messages and page errors are log records too.
042 *
043 * <p>
044 * The trace context is added to requests to the server only, never to requests to other origins,
045 * such as content delivery networks, which have no use for it.
046 */
047public final class Browsing {
048
049        /**
050         * Event name of the log record of a screenshot.
051         */
052        public static final String SCREENSHOT_EVENT = "nasdanika.screenshot";
053
054        /**
055         * Event name of the log record of a browser console message.
056         */
057        public static final String CONSOLE_EVENT = "nasdanika.browser.console";
058
059        /**
060         * Event name of the log record of an uncaught error in the page.
061         */
062        public static final String PAGE_ERROR_EVENT = "nasdanika.browser.page_error";
063
064        /**
065         * The screenshot's name, as given.
066         */
067        public static final AttributeKey<String> SCREENSHOT_NAME = AttributeKey.stringKey("nasdanika.screenshot.name");
068
069        /**
070         * The screenshot file, relative to the screenshots directory, with forward slashes.
071         */
072        public static final AttributeKey<String> SCREENSHOT_PATH = AttributeKey.stringKey("nasdanika.screenshot.path");
073
074        /**
075         * {@code before}, {@code after} or {@code failure} for a screenshot a step took,
076         * {@code explicit} for one taken with {@link Session#screenshot(String)}.
077         */
078        public static final AttributeKey<String> SCREENSHOT_PHASE = AttributeKey.stringKey("nasdanika.screenshot.phase");
079
080        /**
081         * The position of a screenshot in the session, from 1.
082         */
083        public static final AttributeKey<Long> SCREENSHOT_INDEX = AttributeKey.longKey("nasdanika.screenshot.index");
084
085        /**
086         * The position of a step in the session, from 1.
087         */
088        public static final AttributeKey<Long> STEP_INDEX = AttributeKey.longKey("nasdanika.step.index");
089
090        /**
091         * The page's URL when a screenshot was taken or a message logged.
092         */
093        public static final AttributeKey<String> URL_FULL = AttributeKey.stringKey("url.full");
094
095        public static final AttributeKey<String> BROWSER_NAME = AttributeKey.stringKey("browser.name");
096
097        public static final AttributeKey<String> BROWSER_VERSION = AttributeKey.stringKey("browser.version");
098
099        public static final AttributeKey<String> BROWSER_CHANNEL = AttributeKey.stringKey("nasdanika.browser.channel");
100
101        private Browsing() {
102                // Utility
103        }
104
105        /**
106         * Code to run with a browser.
107         *
108         * @param <T> Result type
109         * @param <E> Exception type
110         */
111        @FunctionalInterface
112        public interface BrowserBody<T, E extends Throwable> {
113
114                T run(Session session) throws E;
115
116        }
117
118        /**
119         * With {@link Options#DEFAULT}.
120         */
121        public static <T, E extends Throwable> T inBrowser(Server server, BrowserBody<T, E> body) throws E {
122                return inBrowser(server, Options.DEFAULT, body);
123        }
124
125        /**
126         * Starts Playwright and a browser, opens a page whose relative URLs resolve against the
127         * server's base, runs the body in a {@code Browser} span, and closes everything.
128         */
129        public static <T, E extends Throwable> T inBrowser(Server server, Options options, BrowserBody<T, E> body) throws E {
130                try {
131                        Files.createDirectories(options.screenshots());
132                } catch (IOException e) {
133                        throw new UncheckedIOException(e);
134                }
135                Map<String, String> environment = new HashMap<>();
136                if (options.channel() != null) {
137                        // An installed browser: Playwright's own is not needed
138                        environment.put("PLAYWRIGHT_SKIP_BROWSER_DOWNLOAD", "1");
139                }
140                try (Playwright playwright = Playwright.create(new Playwright.CreateOptions().setEnv(environment));
141                                Browser browser = playwright.chromium().launch(new BrowserType.LaunchOptions()
142                                                .setChannel(options.channel())
143                                                .setHeadless(options.headless()));
144                                BrowserContext context = browser.newContext(new Browser.NewContextOptions()
145                                                .setBaseURL(server.base().toString())
146                                                .setViewportSize(options.width(), options.height()))) {
147
148                        // Requests to the server carry the span current when the browser sends them: Playwright
149                        // calls handlers on the thread that is waiting in a Playwright call, the test's thread
150                        context.route(server.base() + "**", route -> propagate(server, route));
151
152                        AttributesBuilder attributes = Attributes.builder()
153                                        .put(BROWSER_NAME, browser.browserType().name())
154                                        .put(BROWSER_VERSION, browser.version());
155                        if (options.channel() != null) {
156                                attributes.put(BROWSER_CHANNEL, options.channel());
157                        }
158                        return Telemetry.inSpan(Telemetry.tracer(server.openTelemetry()), "Browser", attributes.build(), span -> {
159                                Page page = context.newPage();
160                                Session session = new Session(server, options, playwright, browser, context, page);
161                                return body.run(session);
162                        });
163                }
164        }
165
166        private static void propagate(Server server, Route route) {
167                Map<String, String> headers = new HashMap<>(route.request().headers());
168                headers.putAll(server.propagationHeaders(Context.current()));
169                route.resume(new Route.ResumeOptions().setHeaders(headers));
170        }
171
172}
